title: Total Nobel Prize wins
source_name: Nobel Prize API v2.1, laureates endpoint
definition: Total number of Nobel Prizes (all six categories: Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace, Economic Sciences) awarded to individual laureates, tallied by country of birth (modern-day country, i.e. historical birthplaces mapped to today's borders). Excludes prizes awarded to organizations, which have no country of birth.
notes: Faroe Islands and Guadeloupe births merged into Denmark and France respectively (constituent parts of those states); Scotland and Northern Ireland births merged into United Kingdom. 3 of 990 individual laureates (Abdulrazak Gurnah 2021 Literature, James A. Robinson 2024 Economics, John M. Martinis 2025 Physics) have no birthplace recorded in the Nobel API and are excluded, so totals may undercount by 1 prize each for their (unknown) birth countries.
